## How I checked it

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (needs Chrome, Edge or Chromium)
- [ ] I tried it in the browser, in light and dark mode, if it changes what people see
- [ ] If I changed parsing or saving: a Markdown file that exercises it is in `test/fixtures/`
- [ ] If I added or changed a dependency: `npm run notices` was run and its license is permissive (MIT, BSD, ISC, Apache, OFL)
